say: This is Alex. Six years on his Roblox account.
Then, one message. Free Robux. Just log in to claim.
So he did. Password. Two-step code.
Seconds later, his email and password were changed. He was locked out.
He contacted Roblox Support, which is free. But he couldn't prove the account was his.
One short form, free to send. And notice: no password. We never ask for it.
We told him the price up front. Then we got to work.
We worked out what proof Roblox needed, wrote his support request, and T one, our case agent, followed up with Roblox every day.
Until Roblox verified it was his.
Then we helped him lock it down.
Tranom. Recover what's yours, at tranom dot com.
